all_host_lower: For n=(1^s), m nonincreasing with t>=max(3,s-1), J>=m1+sum(mj)+sum_{j=3..s-1}mj
exact_family: For any s>=3 and t>=max(3,s-1), if m1=...=m_(s-1)=b then J=(2s-3)b+sum_{j=s..t}mj, with arbitrarily nonuniform tail
proof: First residual red vertex-star produces full F(m) after deleting vertex v. Colour s-1 largest H star components red, remaining edges blue. This avoids red s-edge matching. Blue residual target needs M-m1 edges; at most m2 use v; outside v there are only H tail M-sum first s-1 plus q extras, hence q>=sum m3..m_(s-1). Canonical antidiagonal supplies upper.

original_transfer: Given an individually proved sharp J, if original n1=1 or m1=1, hypothetical original E<W forces Delta<=n1+m1-2 while all-blue/all-red implies Delta>=other leader; contradiction. Hence matching-leading original value equals W.
